subject: microbiology
title: Rubella, Congenital Rubella Syndrome and Coronavirus Diagnosis

steps.tx: **Rubella** is a mild febrile exanthem caused by a togavirus-like RNA virus spread by respiratory droplets, with postauricular and suboccipital lymphadenopathy and a fine pink rash spreading from face downward. Adults, especially women, may have transient arthritis. The illness matters chiefly because infection in early pregnancy can damage the fetus.
steps.say: Rubella is trivial in children and teratogenic in early pregnancy.

left.title: Acquired rubella
points: Rash starts on face, lasts about three days

right.title: Lookalikes
points: Measles: cough, coryza, conjunctivitis and Koplik spots

steps.tx: **Congenital rubella syndrome** follows maternal infection especially in the first trimester, causing cataracts, patent ductus arteriosus and sensorineural deafness in the classic triad, plus microcephaly, growth restriction, hepatosplenomegaly and thrombocytopenic blueberry muffin lesions. Infants can shed virus for months and infect susceptible contacts.
steps.say: Cataract, heart defect and deafness are the congenital rubella triad to recall instantly.

left.title: Classic triad
points: Patent ductus arteriosus or pulmonary artery hypoplasia

steps.tx: Prevention depends on **MMR vaccination** before pregnancy and identification of non-immune women. Rubella IgG documents immunity; acute infection in pregnancy is assessed with IgM, avidity and reference testing because IgM can persist or cross-react. Live rubella vaccine is avoided during pregnancy, and pregnancy is usually deferred for a short interval after vaccination.
steps.say: Check rubella immunity before pregnancy, because vaccination cannot be given once pregnant.

steps.tx: **SARS-CoV-2** is a betacoronavirus whose spike protein binds ACE2. Diagnosis uses RT-PCR or other nucleic acid amplification from a respiratory specimen; antigen tests are fastest early with high viral load but less sensitive. Cycle threshold values are platform dependent and should not be converted loosely into contagiousness. Serology is not a routine acute diagnostic.
steps.say: For acute coronavirus infection, respiratory NAAT or antigen testing answers; serology dates the past.

left.title: RT-PCR
points: Detects RNA after infectivity may have fallen

right.title: Antigen test
points: Positive result is actionable in compatible illness
